controlAreas.description: The corpus is identified by its snapshot hash and record count.
The corpus provenance is recorded in the ingest chain and source registry.
The corpus integrity is verified by comparing the snapshot hash and record count.
The verification is deterministic: 100x byte-identical output is enforced by gate G-6.
Each source carries its licence class and attribution.
The corpus coverage is described by collection counts and total record count.
The honest degradation matrix is documented in docs/degradation-matrix.md. The quarantinedRows field records rows that were fetched but not served.
The run ledger is independently auditable by the judge-runnable chain verify script.
